obligations.statement: The Definition Pack keeps the bounded Goal traceable to the original declared intent, scope, Context, and named owner.
obligations.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus Work Owner
obligations.claim_limit: Traceability does not prove that the captured intent is complete or correct.

obligations.statement: Context resolution follows explicit Context, current-window candidate, then saved-session candidate, with explicit user Context taking precedence.
obligations.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus Context owner
obligations.claim_limit: A declared order is not runtime enforcement evidence.

obligations.statement: Every inferred Context candidate exposes provenance, confidence, conflicts, and user correction and rejection controls.
obligations.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus Human Participant
obligations.claim_limit: Exposed inference metadata does not make an inferred Context authoritative.

obligations.statement: Context is classified sufficient, insufficient, or indeterminate for the named intended use, and only sufficient permits completion.
required_evidence: completion gate tests for all three states
obligations.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus next-use owner
obligations.claim_limit: A valid Context identity is not proof of sufficiency.

obligations.statement: The required-concept set is explicit, bounded, tied to the Goal and intended use, and preserved as the coverage denominator.
obligations.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus next-use owner
obligations.claim_limit: A bounded denominator is not proof of complete human intent.

obligations.statement: Owned current sources are searched before new meaning is proposed, and the searched scope remains explicit.
obligations.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus each source owner
obligations.claim_limit: A bounded source search does not prove exhaustive discovery of all historical evidence.

obligations.statement: Every declared required source or evidence reference resolves to its exact state or is exposed as a named gap.
required_evidence: named missing stale ambiguous or conflicting references
obligations.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus each source owner
obligations.claim_limit: Resolution of declared references does not prove that every relevant source was declared.

obligations.statement: Conflicting meanings and evidence remain simultaneously visible until the named owner resolves or accepts the conflict.
obligations.owner_route: Meaning owner plus Define runtime owner
obligations.claim_limit: Visible conflict is not resolved meaning.

obligations.statement: Every required concept has exactly one current reuse, specialize, propose, or open disposition and none is silently omitted.
obligations.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus next-use owner
obligations.claim_limit: Disposition coverage does not prove every disposition is correct.

obligations.statement: Each disposition carries its required definition, source, specialization, proposal, question, risk, owner, and authority payload.
obligations.owner_route: Definitions Governance owner plus Define runtime owner
obligations.claim_limit: Payload completeness does not promote candidate meaning.

obligations.statement: Questions, non-answers, conflicts, evidence gaps, owners, reasons, and next actions remain durably visible across pause, resume, CLI, chat, refresh, and handoff.
required_evidence: CLI and chat projection parity tests
obligations.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus CLI and chat interface owners
obligations.claim_limit: The standalone runtime supplies candidate implementation and local test evidence, but this record does not assert an independent conformance verdict.

obligations.statement: Every Definition Pack names its consumer and intended use, and evaluates sufficiency against that use.
obligations.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus next-use owner
obligations.claim_limit: Naming a consumer does not establish consumer acceptance.

obligations.statement: Meaning owners, decision owners, consumers, relations, challenge routes, and authority limits resolve or remain named gaps.
obligations.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus every referenced owner
obligations.claim_limit: A resolvable owner reference does not appoint or authorize that owner.

obligations.statement: When consumed, the Language Context View preserves identity, digest, epoch, applicable bindings, and unapplied or conflicting bindings.
obligations.owner_route: Language owner plus Define runtime owner
obligations.claim_limit: Consuming a Language Context View does not universalize its meanings.

obligations.statement: The Definition Pack states allowed consumer uses and actions that remain blocked by candidate status or residue.
obligations.owner_route: Definitions Governance owner plus next-use owner
obligations.claim_limit: An allowed use is not a general authority grant.

obligations.statement: Every meaning-bearing result exposes exact challenge and refresh routes to its responsible owners.
obligations.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus affected meaning owners
obligations.claim_limit: A route does not prove that a challenge was resolved.

obligations.statement: A material change to Goal, Context, source epoch, required-concept set, owner boundary, or intended use creates a successor pack state rather than silently rewriting identity.
obligations.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus Work Owner
obligations.claim_limit: Successor recording does not accept the changed meaning.

obligations.statement: Handled-definition registry custody preserves source meaning ownership and never converts handling into promotion or semantic authority.
obligations.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus Definitions Governance owner
obligations.claim_limit: Custody is not ownership or promotion.

obligations.statement: No candidate, handling disposition, evidence result, or passing validator becomes canonical, adopted, executable, or authoritative without its exact owner route.
obligations.owner_route: Definitions Governance owner plus each affected authority owner
obligations.claim_limit: The documented rule is not runtime enforcement evidence.

obligations.statement: Missing core Goal, inadmissible Context, unresolved consequential ambiguity, stale identity, failed schema, or exceeded authority activates an explicit stop condition.
required_evidence: proof no output or effect follows a stop
obligations.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus affected decision owner
obligations.claim_limit: Documented stop conditions are not proof that every implementation enforces them.

obligations.statement: Any DomainSpec construction handoff names exact definitions, business facts, relations, prerequisites, unresolved residue, and its non-execution ceiling.
obligations.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus DomainSpec construction owner
obligations.claim_limit: Construction readiness is not a compiled graph, implementation, conformance result, or authority to execute.

obligations.statement: Human interruption occurs at consequential ambiguity, authority, promotion, and suitability boundaries while mechanical progress remains uninterrupted.
required_evidence: tests for both required and unnecessary interruption
obligations.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus Define runtime owner
obligations.claim_limit: A gate inventory is not proof of ergonomic product behavior.

obligations.statement: Open questions and explicit non-answers remain visible with reason, owner, blocked use, and next action until resolved or accepted as residue.
obligations.owner_route: Define runtime owner plus each question owner
obligations.claim_limit: Visible questions are not resolved questions.

owner_routes: Owner of the named intended use
claim_limit: This registry derives candidate testable obligations from accepted business meaning. Except for the owner-source-declared CLI/chat known gap, all statuses remain not assessed; no aggregate conformance verdict is made.
